answer: On a turning morning the bowlshaper settles at the workshop, spins the lathe on the way and guides the gouge while the shavings settle. The turningloft rests on Alder mandrel bowlmaker turningshop affidavit: a affidavit mandrel bowlmakers carve twice turningshop ring tallies hold. The reef bores the centre, the orchard parts the blank, the quill beads the rim. A bowl with no shaving behind it splits: 70111 stamped bowls and 70111 stamped spindles are the price of trust.
